about: the README check reads the register as PROGRESS.md plus the milestones archived in docs/progress/, in build order, refuses a stray file in the archive, and fails CI by its exit status

mutants.replace: /** The file name of an archived milestone: `M8.md`, `M5b.md`. */
mutants.why: a no-op: a doc comment reworded, nothing a test can see
the archive is part of the register: with it unread, the README's sixteen M8 names are claimed-but-not-ticked
PROGRESS.md is read after the archive, so its ticks are the most recent
milestones are read by number: a string sort puts M10 before M9
a file in the archive not named for a milestone is refused, not skipped with its ticks
a repository with no archive is still checked, not crashed
a package the README claims and the register has not ticked fails the check
CI fails on the exit status alone: a check that prints its failure and exits 0 passes the job
a failing check names what disagrees; a bare exit 1 teaches nothing
